subject: [PATCH v3 11/11] mm, swap: widen swap_info_struct max/pages to unsigned long

2026-08-06.patch_summary: This patch widens the max and pages fields in swap_info_struct from unsigned int to unsigned long, allowing the vswap device to exceed its current limit of 16 TB (16 terabytes) and reach a new maximum of approximately 8 petabytes. This change is necessary because the cluster_info_pool xarray's allocator limit exceeds the original limit. The physical swap remains unaffected by this change.
